description.value: Sake Dining Hashigo is a boutique Japanese sake bar steps from Davie and Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, operated by the Zakkushi Group. The restaurant stocks more than 15 varieties of sake, offers tasting flights, and serves Japanese small plates such as sashimi and oden designed for sake pairing. It is part of a family of Japanese restaurants spanning Vancouver and Toronto, giving it an established reputation in the city's Japanese dining scene.
